parameters.name: KvList
parameters.description: The list of key-value pairs to batch set. The total size cannot exceed 2 MB (2\*1000\*1000).

sub_parameters.name: Expiration
sub_parameters.description: The expiration time as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The value cannot be earlier than the current time. If both Expiration and ExpirationTtl are specified, ExpirationTtl takes precedence.

sub_parameters.name: ExpirationTtl
sub_parameters.description: The expiration time as a relative time in seconds. If both Expiration and ExpirationTtl are specified, ExpirationTtl takes precedence.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The key name to set. The key name can be up to 512 characters in length and cannot contain spaces or backslashes (/).

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The name specified when you called [CreateKvNamespace](~~2850317~~).
